summary: Iteration 9: validated Mercury Banking admin endpoints (status/accounts/reconciliation) with admin vs customer JWT, Google social auth 401 (not 500) on invalid session_id, Driver Onboarding step-3 required-document enforcement, and Admin Panel Banking tab UI. 9/9 backend pytest passed. All 4 review-request features verified working.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (ObjectId not JSON serializable) - PRE-EXISTING, not in this review scope but breaks Admin Panel Users/Orders tabs

action_items: (Optional, not in this scope) Fix Mongo ObjectId serialization in /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders - they return 500 (visible in console logs as 'Error fetching users/orders' on Admin Panel load). Exclude _id from response.
critical_code_review_comments: Mercury banking implementation is clean — admin-only guard works (customer JWT correctly receives 403 on status/accounts/reconciliation).
POST /api/auth/social/google correctly returns 401 with detail on invalid session_id and does not 500 on missing session_id.

DriverOnboarding.js validateStep + getMissingDocuments correctly blocks 'Next Step' on docs step with destructive toast listing missing documents; submit button is only rendered on review step and is properly gated by getMissingDocuments().length > 0.
AdminMercuryBanking.js renders all required data-testids (admin-mercury-content, mercury-accounts-grid with 3 cards, mercury-recon-summary, Connected badge) and integrates with backend via admin JWT.
Several admin console errors fetching users/orders (500) - pre-existing ObjectId bug, unrelated to this iteration's changes.
test_credentials: Admin/customer created at runtime with timestamp emails (qaadmin_<ts>@gmail.com / qacust_<ts>@gmail.com, password Admin1234!). Tokens used via Authorization: Bearer header and localStorage.token for UI flows.
seed_data_creation: Two fresh accounts per run (admin + customer) via /api/auth/register. No persistent seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features in this review_request pass. The pre-existing /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders 500s (ObjectId serialization) are visible in Admin Panel console but DO NOT block the Banking tab. If user reports Admin Panel issues, fix those endpoints (exclude _id in MongoDB query responses). Mercury uses a LIVE token (3 real accounts at $0); Stripe is in test mode so reconciliation summary shows 0 payouts - that is expected, not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in the requested scope. Bonus finding: /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders raise TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable in jsonable_encoder. RCA: response models likely return raw Mongo documents containing _id ObjectId. Mitigation: exclude _id from MongoDB find projection OR cast _id to str OR define Pydantic response_model that omits _id.
